exec("from pathlib import Path
from bale_listener import CHAT_ID, send_message
from tsetmc_first_source import build_tsetmc_snapshot
from underlying_trend_engine import fetch_underlying_context
from last_minute_profit_engine import build_last_minute_ranking
import json
snapshot = build_tsetmc_snapshot(flow=None, max_instruments=None, symbol_prefix=None)
rows = snapshot.get("rows", [])
ids = sorted({str((r.get("identity") or {}).get("underlying_id") or "").strip() for r in rows if str((r.get("identity") or {}).get("underlying_id") or "").strip()})
ctx = fetch_underlying_context(ids)
result = build_last_minute_ranking(rows, top_count=15, underlying_context=ctx.get("instruments", {}), snapshot=snapshot)
lines = ["🔥 سود لحظه آخری","مبنای داده: "+str(snapshot.get("data_mode") or "داده موجود نیست"),"وضعیت داده: "+str(snapshot.get("live_refresh_status") or "داده موجود نیست"),"تعداد کاندیدا: "+str(result.get("candidate_count",0)),"تعداد نمایش: "+str(result.get("display_count",0)),"━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"]
for x in result.get("ranking_rows", []):
    lines += [str(x.get("rank"))+". "+str(x.get("symbol") or "داده موجود نیست")+" | امتیاز: "+str(x.get("score")),"پایه: "+str(x.get("underlying_symbol"))+" | نوع: "+str(x.get("contract_type"))+" | جهت: "+str(x.get("direction")),"قیمت پایه: "+str(x.get("underlying_price"))+" | اعمال: "+str(x.get("strike"))+" | آپشن: "+str(x.get("current_option_price")),"فاصله اعمال: "+str(x.get("moneyness_pct"))+"% | روز باقی‌مانده: "+str(x.get("days_to_expiry")),"━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"]
if not result.get("ranking_rows"): lines.append("فرصت واجد شرایط با شواهد کافی پیدا نشد.")
report="\n".join(lines)
send_message(CHAT_ID,report)
Path("output/last_minute_profit_manual_run.json").write_text(json.dumps({"status":"SUCCESS","data_mode":snapshot.get("data_mode"),"live_refresh_status":snapshot.get("live_refresh_status"),"candidate_count":result.get("candidate_count"),"display_count":result.get("display_count"),"snapshot_sha256":snapshot.get("snapshot_sha256")},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
print("REPORT_SENT")")
